speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. Could you please describe when your gait and limb ataxia began and if the symptoms are getting worse over time?

speaker: Patient
text: I started having trouble walking recently, and people say I look drunk when I walk. I also feel clumsy in my arms and legs, especially on the right side.

speaker: Doctor
text: You mentioned the clumsiness is especially on the right side; has this weakness or coordination issue appeared suddenly, like over hours or days, or has it been gradually worsening? Also, have you experienced any headaches, vomiting, or difficulty speaking?

speaker: Patient
text: I have Crohn disease and it has been difficult to control. I have been taking natalizumab for about a year.

speaker: Doctor
text:
Given your history of Crohn's disease and one year of natalizumab use, I am highly concerned about the possibility of Progressive Multifocal Leukoencephalopathy (PML). I need to rule this out immediately.

REQUEST TEST: MRI_Brain_with_contrast

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: Lesions consistent with Progressive Multifocal Encephalopathy (PML). T1/T2 images showing multifocal demyelinating lesions without gadolinium enhancement, indicative of PML.

speaker: Doctor
text:
The MRI results confirm multifocal demyelinating lesions consistent with Progressive Multifocal Leukoencephalopathy (PML). Given your history of natalizumab use and these specific imaging findings, the diagnosis is clear.

DIAGNOSIS READY: Progressive Multifocal Leukoencephalopathy (PML)
